Message:
ACPI: Eliminate the DEVICE_ACPI_HANDLE() macro

Since DEVICE_ACPI_HANDLE() is now literally identical to
ACPI_HANDLE(), replace it with the latter everywhere and drop its
definition from include/acpi.h.
